name: dnr-flat-pic
title_zh: 把照片压缩成高饱和扁平插画，保留构图不描边
tagline_zh: 参考图太密？要图标化但怕丢构图？它做语义压缩，不是描边复刻。出图自带高饱和无渐变，一眼扁平。
tagline_en: Dense photo in, sparse flat vector out—semantic compression, not tracing. Keeps composition, drops detail, boosts.
desc_en: Transform reference photographs and visually dense images into sparse, recognizable, high-saturation flat-vector-style illustrations through semantic compression rather than literal tracing. Use when the user asks for photo-to-flat illustration, photo-to-vector-style redraw, 照片转扁平插画, 无渐变高饱和插画, iconification, visual simplification, composition-preserving abstraction, a consistent minimal illustrati
why_zh: 它不逐像素描轮廓，而是先理解画面里的“物体关系”，再按扁平语法重画。所以构图稳，细节却敢删。
why_en: It reads scene structure first, then redraws in flat-vector grammar—so composition survives while clutter gets dropped.
limit_zh: 只吃单张静态参考图，不吃多图合成或视频帧。产物是扁平插画风格，不是可编辑 SVG 路径。复杂光影会压成纯色块。
limit_en: Single static image only; no video or multi-shot. Output is flat-style raster, not editable SVG. Gradients and fine lighting are flattened away.
